_comment: Hand-picked covers, keyed by reading path slug.
The automatic lookup takes the best-scoring GetComics post and uses whatever
image that post carries. That is right almost always, but the post's image is
sometimes not a cover at all — All-Star Superman matched a 2024 reprint whose
post image is the comic's first interior page ('DOOMED PLANET') — and some
books have no usable post at all.
An entry here wins over everything else. Keep it short: this is an escape
hatch for books the search gets wrong, not a place to curate covers by hand.

all-star-superman-2005-vol-1.note: Search matched the 2024 reprint, whose post image is the first interior page.

batman-the-black-mirror-2010-vol-1.note: No post matched the 2010 issues; this is the 2011 collected edition.
